releases.notes:
# Magic Compass Mod for Minecraft 1.21.11

A comprehensive quality-of-life mod that adds 55+ features accessible through a magical compass!

## Features

### Movement
- Flight toggle
- Speed boost (1x/2x/3x/5x)
- Jump boost (1-5 levels)
- No fall damage
- Water breathing
- Night vision
- Invisibility

### Protection
- God mode
- Fire immunity
- Hunger lock
- Health regeneration
- Armor durability lock
- Potion immunity

### Mining & Building
- Instant break
- Vein miner
- Tree chopper
- Place range extender (+3/+5/+10 blocks)
- Auto replant crops
- Keep inventory
- Infinite tool durability

### Inventory
- Creative menu access
- Item magnet (3/5/10 block range)

### World Control
- Time control (freeze/day/night)
- Weather control
- Teleport home
- Chunk loader
- Mob spawn control
- Entity clear

### Combat & Visual
- One-hit kill
- Mobs ignore player
- Freeze mobs
- Auto totem
- Range multiplier
- Fullbright
- Entity ESP
- Ore highlight
- Coordinate display

## Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader 0.18.1+ for Minecraft 1.21.11
2. Install Fabric API 0.140.0+1.21.11
3. Place the mod JAR in your mods folder
4. Launch Minecraft

## Usage

Right-click the Magic Compass (given automatically on first join) to open the GUI. Navigate through 6 pages of features using the arrow buttons.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.18.1+
- Fabric API 0.140.0+
- SGui 1.12.0+
- Java 21
